title: Citizens Financial Services faces Q3 loan quality decline impacting operations
digest: Citizens Financial Services reported a decline in Q3 loan quality, impacting its operations according to Seeking Alpha (2026-11-17). The analysis noted rising non-performing loans and higher provisions for loan losses, with specific mentions of commercial real estate and consumer credit segments facing stress. No conflicting reports were identified in the provided data.
